candidate_source: C. nipponicum DFR/ANS sequence candidates frozen by Stage A

TRANSCRIPT_STRONG.interpretation: strong positive evidence that a homologous transcript/coding sequence is present in this young-leaf library

TRANSCRIPT_POSITIVE.interpretation: positive evidence of homologous transcript presence; insufficient for floral function

NO_POSITIVE_EVIDENCE.interpretation: no qualifying positive transcript evidence under this screen; cannot be interpreted as genomic deletion, pathway loss, or floral non-expression

primary_retention_question: Do all three white public individuals show positive DFR and/or ANS transcript evidence under the same frozen criteria, and is any target retained across both colour classes?

decision_classes.RETENTION_BOTH_TARGETS_ACROSS_BOTH_MORPH: DFR and ANS each have positive evidence in at least two of three W and at least two of three BP samples, with no morph class showing universal target absence.
decision_classes.RETENTION_PARTIAL: At least one target shows positive evidence across both morph classes, but the full two-target criterion is not met.
decision_classes.ANCESTRY_OR_TISSUE_LIMITED: Positive evidence is sparse or restricted such that young-leaf expression/sample structure dominates interpretation.
decision_classes.NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: technical retrieval, candidate orthology, or read quality prevents a comparable six-run screen.
